limitations: Every checked-in file is original project material or a hand-authored descriptor; no Apache JMeter plan, result, log, binary, source, or captured usage/version output is redistributed.
The small JMX, properties, and Log4j2 XML files are bounded future inputs only. They were not loaded by Java/JMeter or jmeter-rs while creating this corpus.

The option catalog covers all 30 documented short/long pairs, including -E/--proxyScheme, and marks repeatability and LAST support explicitly. Exact acceptance and precedence remain pinned-oracle work.
Help/version vocabulary is a mode-specific token-set target under NORM-CLI-001; localized prose, whitespace, numeric exits, and output bytes are not asserted by this static corpus.

The -j paired-quote date pattern is intentionally source-ambiguous: the research baseline names SimpleDateFormat, while this corpus does not assert a pinned NewDriver formatter. The engine remains null/unasserted until exact-source and oracle review.

Legal/illegal and report-only scenarios record documented rules and oracle-required probes. Fatal Throwable/System.exit is a source-derived termination category only; process_exit remains null and unasserted until evidence.

inputs/runner-contract.json records future setup obligations for fresh output directories, direct-child bounded shutdown/reaping, local loopback RMI, unavailable-registry failure, stop-failure induction, and target-specific PATH/locale materialization; it is not an implementation.
Logging descriptors retain stream/category/exit comparisons and the paired-quote -j date-pattern probe without fabricating log text or log bytes.
No shell fixture, remote service, network endpoint, Java runtime, JMeter runtime, jmeter-rs process, or subprocess was started.
